description: Get the tasks of a sprint, i.e. the tasks contained in the sprint's List. Returns the task list with status, assignees and dates. Use to review sprint scope or progress.

include_closed.description: If true, also include closed/done tasks. Defaults to false (open tasks only).

sprint_list_id.description: ID of the sprint List (from `list_sprints` or `get_active_sprint`).

subtasks.description: If true, include subtasks in the result.

name: get_sprint_tasks
